top_flagged_examples.control_description: Unamended soil (no biochar, no organic amendment)
top_flagged_examples.notes: Values estimated from Figure 2B. Duncan letter 'ab'. Text highlights AC as showing 'highly significant stimulation'. AC was purchased (Sigma-Aldrich), pyrolysis temperature unknown. Lowest H/C ratio (0.21) among all biochars. Additive interactions with all NPOA types in mixtures (Figure 4B).

top_flagged_examples.treatment_description: Commercial Fagus wood biochar at 2% w/w (10 g per 500 g pot)
top_flagged_examples.control_description: Unamended soil (no biochar, no organic amendment)
top_flagged_examples.notes: Values estimated from Figure 2B. Duncan letter 'a' (highest growth). Commercial biochar from Fagus wood, purchased from local market — pyrolysis conditions unknown. Strongest growth promotion among all 10 biochars (+225% vs control). Low H/C (0.37) consistent with paper's finding that H/C is best predictor of biochar growth promotion.
